integrity: Algebraic proofs are supplied with reproducible standalone finite-case crosschecks; no external independent audit or certification has taken place.
scientific_limitations: The formulas cover generalized dihedral groups with nontrivial odd-order abelian kernel, and ordinary dihedral groups of every width at least three; they do not settle the all-nonabelian group problem. Historical priority cannot be established exhaustively from indexed literature.
title: Exact partial-isomorphism and endomorphism counts for dihedral groups
